text: US intelligence assessed that the crown prince approved the 2018 operation that killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi.

source.name: US Office of the Director of National Intelligence
source.quote: We assess that Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Muhammad bin Salman approved an operation in Istanbul, Turkey to capture or kill Saudi journalist Jamal Khashoggi.

additionalSources.name: CNBC, "U.S. says Saudi crown prince approved Khashoggi killing, imposes visa restrictions on 76 Saudis"
additionalSources.quote: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman approved an operation to capture or kill journalist Jamal Khashoggi in 2018, according to a U.S. intelligence report
